text_block_list.text:
Let's deepen our mutual understanding―― 
It had been a little while since that
conversation.

A normal day.
Thinking about future training menus, 
organizing documents,
planning future races――

After finishing that,
having lunch. Going to the cafeteria and 
exchanging information and making small talk
with colleagues.
A normal day……except for one thing.

I already knew who it was though,
because inevitably, 
she would enter my view. However……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……"The Oort Cloud"…… nothing 『Special』…… 
a 『Person』 and their daily activities……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
But "Observation" is still unfeasible. 
……a "Concept"?
It exists but "cannot be discerned"……

I suppose she was just observing,
so I didn't 
do anything to try and stop her. But……

But if she was going to do this several
days 
in a row,
it was probably a good idea to talk 
to her. Rather, since we have the chance――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Big Bang"……I've been noticed…… 
Neo Universe's 『Heart Skipped a Beat』……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…………。
……"Stabilization". ……Haaaaa……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, 『Closer』. 
……"Observation" will continue at close
range.

Saying that,
Neo Universe once again continued staring 
at me.
Although it was difficult to understand her
words, 
it was probably possible to understand her
actions.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(……"METI"……? 
Trainer is trying to read the
"trajectory"……?)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(……I need to "Observe" more closely…… 
If I miss it,
it'll be like a "Shooting Star"……)

As if to make sure she missed nothing, 
her restless gaze continued to focus on
me.

When I first met her,
it seemed like she had this unique 
atmosphere that made her seem aloof and out
of reach, but now――

Seeing her like this,
she seemed more like an innocent, 
curious puppy……though thinking that might
be a little rude.

Looking at Neo Universe like that,
I couldn't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……Today we're 『Outside School』. 
『Different』 from normal…… that's why,
Trainer too……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…… Trainer. 
Neo Universe "seeks" to go on a 『Walk』.

On Neo Universe's suggestion,
we decided to go for a walk. 
For now,
we decided to just pick a random store……

……There was no particular conversation
though.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……A "Phenomenon" that can't be
『Explained』. 
It's necessary for it to 『Resolve』 by
『Itself』……

She probably meant 『I want to solve this
myself』……I guess. 
There was definitely something bothering her,
but it didn't 
seem to be a serious issue.

If that's the case,
then there's no reason to worry. 
Leaving the shopping mall,
we continued the leisurely stroll.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……『Hydration』 required. 
"Polaris" is not visible,
but there is a 『Destination』.

『I'm thirsty』 is probably what she meant. 
That was easy to understand――so easy,
I couldn't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……"Satisfied",
it seems……"Guidance" was smooth. 
Part of Trainer's "cycle"……?
Neo Universe finished drinking her juice.

She was……probably asking if this was my
favorite shop or how 
often I came.
Judging by her expression it was probably
the latter.
choice_data_list: Um……once in a while I guess?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……I see……
Seems like I was correct.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……"Psc"……on the surface of the water……they're
sticking 
their mouths out……do they require
"Replenishment"?

I looked out on to the lake and saw fish
gathered at the surface. 
No doubt,
she was asking 『Do they want food?』……!
choice_data_list: They should be selling some nearby!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
………… 
……Mmm. Neo Universe wants to "seek" it.

It really turned out to be an easy-going
time, 
wandering without a goal in mind.
Neo Universe's 
expression had remained unchanged, but――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…………Neo Universe wasn't thinking about
whether it was 『Fun』……

It didn't seem like she was going to say it
wasn't fun. 
She was thinking about something else……I
guess that's what it means?

She really was a mysterious girl.
She had a unique atmosphere, 
and sometime it seemed she had a vague
presence――But――

The current Neo Universe seemed to be
struggling with this question.
She just seemed like a normal 
Uma Musume who didn't understand much about
herself……

I laughed at that gap between
personalities

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(………… 
Trainer is always 『Thinking』.
Always "Oscillating".)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(……It's 『Mysterious』. 
Unlike 『Other People』……not creating a
"Vacuum")

I once again felt a gaze.
Once again it was from 
the Uma Musume in front of me.
Communication might not be smooth,
but this was fine in it's own way――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
……Affirmative. 
Neo Universe will 『Return』 with Trainer.

……it seemed like this would be kind of
fun.
